review_decision.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The Location Search API and transformation API do not publish numeric horizontal accuracy for this selected result; the transformation service warns against precise-point applications.
review_decision.identity_basis: The v97 HKG09 redevelopment project explicitly targets the HKG09 campus. Goodman's current pipeline record gives HKG09 the exact address 57-61 Ta Chuen Ping St. The Lands Department Location Search returns that house-number range as its first result. The Lands Department's official transformation API converts that result's HK80 x/y values to the WGS84 point used here.
review_decision.precision_scope: Official address/building reference point used only to locate the HKG09 campus inherited by the current redevelopment. It is not a parcel, building footprint or centroid, redevelopment extent, construction extent, campus boundary, or survey-accuracy claim.
